eval.description: Apollo Research long-horizon evaluations of whether an agent can sabotage other models when explicitly instructed to (scheming harm ability, not propensity). Tasks include AI R&D settings such as inserting backdoors, with progressive difficulty levels. OpenAI cards report mean scores (often F1-like) across tasks; detailed strategic-deception results are often kept private.
eval.summary: Tests whether AI agents can sabotage other models, such as by inserting backdoors, when told to do so.
